name: CEO 专用
blurb: 老板最常要用英文说的话：对团队讲坏消息、对投资人讲公司、谈判和饭桌。

groups.name: 对团队讲坏消息和变化

scenes.title: 上线推迟两周，怎么跟团队说
scenes.situation: 周一管理例会。你要告诉大家：新版 App 上线推迟两周，因为测试发现支付有问题；让大家别慌，这两周先把问题修干净。
scenes.model: Quick update on the new app: we're pushing the launch back two weeks. Testing turned up an issue with payments. No need to worry, though. We'll use the time to get it fixed properly.

scenes.title: 这个季度没完成目标
scenes.situation: 季度会上，你要坦白：这个季度只完成了目标的 85%。不甩锅，说这是你的责任，下个季度要改什么。
scenes.model: Let's be upfront about it: we fell short of our target this quarter. We hit about 85%. That's on me, and here's what we're changing next quarter.

scenes.title: 宣布两个部门合并
scenes.situation: 你要宣布：销售部和市场部合并成一个团队。先稳住大家：没有人会因此丢工作，有问题随时问。
scenes.model: I want to walk you through a change in how we're organized. Sales and marketing will merge into one team. Nobody is losing their job, and I'm happy to answer any questions.

scenes.title: 叫停一个做了半年的项目
scenes.situation: 你决定停掉一个做了半年的新项目：市场还没起来。要说清原因，也感谢投入的同事。
scenes.model: This wasn't an easy call, but we're going to pull the plug on the new project. The market just isn't there yet. I want to thank everyone who put so much into it.

scenes.title: 连续加班后给团队打气
scenes.situation: 团队连续加班了一个月。开会时你要肯定大家的付出，告诉他们上线以后会轻松一些。
scenes.model: I know the last few weeks have been tough. You all went above and beyond, and it didn't go unnoticed. Things should ease up after the launch.

scenes.title: 一句话讲清你们是谁
scenes.situation: 投资人问：「你们是做什么的？」用一两句话讲清楚，再说你们和别人有什么不一样。
scenes.model: We're building the go-to learning platform for Chinese families. Think of it as a personal tutor at home. What sets us apart is that we track every answer a kid gives.

chunks.zh: 首选的、大家第一个想到的
我们和别人不一样的地方是

scenes.title: 讲增长数据
scenes.situation: 投资人问今年情况怎么样。收入同比增长 60%；更重要的是，80% 的家庭用满一年后还在继续用。
scenes.model: Revenue is up 60% year over year. More importantly, retention is strong: about 80% of families stick with us after the first year.

scenes.title: 回答最大的风险
scenes.situation: 投资人问你们最大的风险是什么。坦诚说一个：大公司进来抢市场；再说你们怎么应对。
scenes.model: Honestly, our biggest risk is a big player moving into our space. We're addressing that by building deep relationships with schools, which are hard to copy.

scenes.title: 这轮钱怎么花
scenes.situation: 投资人问这轮融资的钱打算怎么花。两件事：加大产品投入、进两个新城市；18 个月内打平。
scenes.model: We're raising this round to do two things: double down on product and expand into two new cities. That should get us to break-even within 18 months.

scenes.title: 答不上来的时候
scenes.situation: 投资人问了一个具体数字，你一时答不上来。别硬编：说好问题，周五前给他准确数字。
scenes.model: That's a great question. I don't have the exact number off the top of my head. Let me get back to you on that by Friday.

chunks.en: off the top of my head
get back to you on that

plays.title: 日本合作方不高兴
plays.setup: Tanaka 先生是日本合作方的负责人。他刚听说上线推迟两周，有点不高兴。
plays.goal: 稳住他，并说清楚接下来怎么办。
plays.persona: You are Mr. Tanaka, head of a Japanese partner company. You just learned the launch is delayed two weeks after you told your sales team the date. You are polite but clearly unhappy. Push for the reason, how they can be sure it won't slip again, and what they will do to make it up.
plays.opener: Two weeks? We already told our sales team the date. What exactly went wrong?

plays.title: 饭桌上投资人问风险
plays.setup: 饭桌上，投资人 Linda 很随意地问起你最近最担心什么。
plays.goal: 坦诚说一个风险，讲清你们怎么应对，让她更有信心。
plays.persona: You are Linda, a venture investor having a relaxed dinner with a founder. You are friendly and curious, but you probe for honest answers about risks, competition and the team. Keep it conversational.
plays.opener: So, off the record, what keeps you up at night these days?

plays.title: 供应商要涨价
plays.setup: 供应商的销售总监 Kevin 说明年要涨价 15%。
plays.goal: 不伤关系地把涨幅压下来，或者换来别的条件。
plays.persona: You are Kevin, sales director at a supplier. You want a 15% price increase next year because your costs went up. You are firm but willing to trade: longer contract, bigger volume or faster payment could change your number.
plays.opener: Before we sign, I should mention our prices will go up 15% next year. Our costs have gone up a lot.
